explanation: The statement is the structure-field projection `Subcoalgebra.comul_mem'` of the `Subcoalgebra` structure defined in this library (AlgebraicGroups/Algebra/Coalgebra/Subcoalgebra.lean, lines 41-47). Its content lives entirely in the library's own definition: Mathlib (commit 83abb3e776bd) has no `Subcoalgebra`/`subcoalgebra` notion at all (grep over Mathlib finds no occurrence), and no declaration stating that the comultiplication of a member of a subspace lies in the range of `TensorProduct.mapIncl` of that subspace. Only generic ingredients exist (`TensorProduct.mapIncl`, `LinearMap.range`, `Submodule.range_subtype`), which do not carry this content. Batteries and Lean core likewise contain nothing relevant.
